## Owner selection and frozen source schema

Rust frozen source SHA-256 eb35c73ead829ed439a347d3cb665d52d3aa4b45b242c1155cfd4377a68d6415.
Rust handoff SHA-256 6e2e7e1961ed4f0a22e8615bbdf48e932e05d163b72ce304ef0b3adb5eca40f1.
Both match the primary-relayed frozen schema. Rust paths were read only here.
Receiving experiment identity, completed source-view identity and full HIR
artifact identity are distinct Lean data. World.completedViews selects the
retained completed view, its experiment is checked against the requested
ExperimentId, and World.experiments is then read at that selected experiment.
Facts/provenance/current representatives are compared to that selected store;
no free ownerFacts/ownerProvenance/ownerCurrent* mirror input exists.

Native source: candidate_receiver.rs InventoryCompletedReificationView.primitive_projection,
InventoryCompletedInstancePrimitiveProjection.validate and reify_qualified_facts;
lib.rs ConstraintStore.require_owned (near 3887); yu-hir/module.rs
HirModule.owns_occurrence (2103). require_owned is exactly admitted-HIR membership
extensionally: indexed success OR fallback scan of admitted hirs, and
owns_occurrence compares full artifact identity only. It does not compare local
ordinal with an experiment token. Lean requireOwned preserves that semantics;
Readbacks also checks every occurrence's retained artifactPositions coordinate
against the selected admitted artifact list. No global artifact uniqueness is
assumed; two experiments may admit the same artifact.
